# Deep-Dive Series

The evidence papers behind the registry rows of the main paper.
Architecture, build instructions, and the review protocol:
[`../README.md`](../README.md). The registry:
[`../ledger.yaml`](../ledger.yaml).

| Paper | File | Scope | Owns |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | [`runtime-grounding.tex`](runtime-grounding.tex) | Grounds the value domain and runtime predicates (tags, strict equality, truthiness, callable/constructible, IsArray, instanceof) in ECMAScript. | L-TAG, A-CTOR-CALL, L-INST, L-ISARR, A-PROTO, A-DDA, A-PROXY, A-HASINST |
| B | [`lattice-operations.tex`](lattice-operations.tex) | Checks union and intersection at each representation layer, including the bottom-implies-disjointness property required by refinement. | L-UNION, L-INTER, L-INTER-BOT, C-FREEZE-CACHE |
| C | [`type-expansion.tex`](type-expansion.tex) | Models type expansion, proves semantic containment in the modes used by refinement, and checks when expansion-cache entries can be reused. | L-EXP, E-NORM, E-ARR, E-CLASS-SYM, E-GUARD, E-PLACEHOLDER-ATOM, E-EXPKEY |
| D | [`subtyping-validation.tex`](subtyping-validation.tex) | The isSub architecture, its caches and coinduction, and per-stratum validation soundness. | L-SUB, E-SIG, A-HASH, L-SUB-FIELDS-SET, L-SUB-CLOSED-ABSENCE, O-GETCOV, O-GETCONTRA, O-ARRAYLIT, F-CABSENT, F-BRAND, F-THIS-IMPLICIT, L-SUB-IDXNAME, A-INTERSEM, L-SUB-TSINST |
| E | [`subst-state-discipline.tex`](subst-state-discipline.tex) | Monotonicity, monotone reads, clone stability, and rollback of the inference substitution. | L-MONO, L-CLONE, OBL-MONOTONE, OBL-RESTORE, MR-1, CL-1, M1, I-F, RB-1, SETCONSTRAINT-FUN, E-TRANSPORT, TENV-EXPANDINTER |
| F | [`refinement-invalidation.tex`](refinement-invalidation.tex) | Determines when mutation invalidates a narrowing, including captured locals, loop back edges, field writes, and calls. | L-LOCAL, L-PURE, L-CAPT, L-STALE-READ, L-LOOP-CARRIED, L-GETSET, ACCESSOR-METHOD |
| G | [`literal-canonicalization.tex`](literal-canonicalization.tex) | Relates stored literal spellings to runtime values and checks whether equality and truthiness reasoning remain sound. | L-LIT, L-LIT-FOLD |
| H | [`view-coherence.tex`](view-coherence.tex) | Checks whether a write accepted through one type of an object preserves the guarantees made by every other live type of that object. | L-MUT-ALIAS, L-MUT-ALIAS-CALL, V-INTER-SET |
